research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: frozen empty occupation list supplemented by two inaugural speeches, valedictory speech, official state and federal biographies, employer hospitality feature, AICD candidate profile/annual report and public professional post.

Hospitality is established but hours and exact intervals are not. The unnamed restaurant at age 18 is not automatically identified as Wrest Point. Employer private control follows the commercial hospitality operation; historical legal payroll entity and ownership dates should still be recovered.

Childhood family-farm chores and later references to irrigation do not establish paid farm employment or self-employment. No paid spell manufactured from those anecdotes. Check any adult business role and concurrent work against declarations.

Carol Brown adviser work and Young Labor vice-presidency appear in an uncited Wikipedia passage. White’s 2010 speech names Brown as a supporter, not an employer. Preserve as leads pending independent evidence, not established spells.

Follow up original Wrest Point interview and staff history, university-era employers and hours, Kerr office appointment/separation and leave, governance exact terms/pay, any employment in the February–May 2025 gap and later concurrent work. No full-time duration, public/private zero or total justified.

Source gaps: direct LinkedIn profile returned DisabledError; public post accessible. Direct APH restricted; health biography returned 400 Timeout; employer ownership submissions returned Internal Error. These individual access failures did not terminate research. Search-indexed ownership material was not used to invent precise historical control dates.

Follow-up2026-10-02: contemporaneous ABC2010candidate profile corroborates Kerr office work and ABC2024report corroborates party governance; neither supplies employment start/end or substantive hours. These corroborations do not qualify as material enrichment for run counts.

Targeted Carol Brown adviser searches returned uncited Wikipedia passage and derivative profiles; ABC Facebook snippets insufficient to verify underlying original profile and direct Facebook returned Online fetch throttled. No new adviser spell asserted. Original SMH Wrest Point interview search found existing GameDeveloper retelling but no new dates/hours. Existing hospitality, party and study exclusions preserved.

Next useful evidence: original employer personnel/appointment records or publicly accessible dated professional history for university hospitality, Kerr/Brown staff roles and 2025gap; governance remuneration and term records. No FT totals can be calculated.
